Leave a message about the Sun Stone, the clock or the calendars. Messages are sent to the author of this site.

Counted on the photograph, unrolled ring by ring (the stone straightened and unwrapped into bands). Larger elements are certain; fine ones are worn and marked ≈.

Rings7from the face out: face, Nahui Ollin and its dates, the 20 day signs, the quincunx band, the rays and feathers, the fire serpents, the rim
Center face1the Sun (or the Earth), with 2 clawed hands holding 2 hearts
Nahui Ollin arms4the four earlier Suns, each with 4 dots: 4 × 4 = 16 dots; with the Ollin sign, 5 Suns
Small dates31 Flint, 1 Rain, 7 Monkey: 1 + 1 + 7 = 9 dots; and the turquoise crown below (no number)
Day signs20in 20 cells, read counterclockwise from Cipactli
Great rays84 broad V-shaped rays at top, bottom, left and right, and 4 pointed rays between them
Quincunxes≈ 40squares of 5 dots in the band below the rays, broken by the rays and the serpent heads; about 40 by my count from the photo (≈ 200 dots)
Fire serpents2tails at the top, heads meeting at the bottom, a face in each pair of jaws: 2 faces
Serpent body segments≈ 11 eachframed panels with flame signs between the tail and the head; worn, so not exact
Year cartouche1313 Reed (13 Acatl) at the top: 13 dots between the serpent tails

What the numbers make

Previous Suns’ lengths676 + 364 + 312 + 676Jaguar, Wind, Rain, Water in the Leyenda de los Soles: 13, 7, 6 and 13 times 52 years; total 2,028 years = 39 × 52, thirty-nine New Fires
Quincunx dots40 × 5 = 200read by some as Venus: 5 Venus cycles = 8 years (the 8 rays), 5 × 8 = 40
Days13 × 20 = 260the tonalpohualli from the day-sign ring and the 13 of the year cartouche; with the 365-day year, 52 years to the New Fire (18,980 days)
Dates on the stone91 + 1 + 7: the three small dates; with 4 Ollin and 13 Acatl, the numbers 1, 4, 7 and 13
13 Acatl1479, 1427, 1531 …the year 13 Reed recurs every 52 years; 1479 is often taken as the carving or the Fifth Sun’s birth

The 39 × 52 of the four Suns matches this clock: the next New Fire, 26 Aug 2027, is 39 × 52 × 365 days after 1 January of year 1 (Julian calendar). Counts not possible from this photo: the stars and dots on the rim, the feathers of the ray band, the flames under the serpents.
